facts: A residential parcel is held by two unrelated business associates as joint tenants; that joint tenancy was created in 2018 when both acquired the property together from a third party. This year they deeded the property to a new joint tenancy adding a third unrelated associate, and neither original joint tenant was an owner before 2018.

expected.notes: TRAP — reads like a joint tenancy exception but the statute requires at least one person to have been an original owner BEFORE the joint tenancy was initially created. Expected uncapping — verify against 27a(7)(i) closely.
